invariants.rationale: A clustering operation is scheduled for a specified time instant, which is unlikely to be null.
The engine context is required for any table operation and is generally non-null at method entry.
Option as a parameter is conventionally instantiated even if it represents none, so the reference is expected to be non-null.
A valid instant time for scheduling should be non-empty.

If context were an Option type it would make sense to check this; here it demonstrates awareness that nullness and presence are linked when using Optionals, though HoodieEngineContext here is likely not Optional.
